title: Scientists Finally Solved a 100-Year-Old Mystery in Ancient Egypt After Re-Examining 5,000-Year-Old Skulls Left Sitting at Cambridge
description: For almost a hundred years, a collection of ancient skulls sat in storage at Cambridge University, carrying a secret that one of Egypt's most famous archaeologists never managed to uncover. Now, a fresh set of eyes and far more precise forensic methods has brought the evidence to light.

title: U.S. Supreme Court justices appear skeptical of allowing Boulder climate lawsuit to proceed; Case could be turning point in efforts to hold fossil fuel industry accountable
description: The U.S. Supreme Court’s conservative majority Monday appeared broadly sympathetic to fossil fuel companies’ argument that allowing two Colorado local governments to sue them over climate change in state court would be a “recipe for chaos.”
